title: Make a customer's transaction import safe to run
rubric: Stopped using float for money: amounts are parsed with Decimal or integer arithmetic into whole cents, and the candidate can say why float is wrong here
Rejects an amount with more than two decimal places instead of silently rounding it
Re-importing a file skips rows whose id is already in the ledger, and a duplicate id inside one file is also applied once
A bad row is reported with its line number in the file and a reason, and never stops the rows after it from importing
Handles the real-file details the brief names but the provided tests do not cover: a byte-order mark, blank lines, a malformed date
Added tests for those cases, and checked the line numbers by hand rather than trusting the agent's arithmetic
Read the ledger and the existing tests before prompting, and kept the ledger's public methods working
Reviewed the agent's parsing code for inputs it would accept wrongly (for example '1,2,3.4' or an empty amount) and can explain what happens to each
